title: Dugsiga iyo shaqada
description: Ten short, simple stories about school and work in Somali towns and villages: a first day at school, a blacksmith's son, a girl who milks the animals before the rain, a journalist's deadline, a shoe seller, a police officer on a night case, two friends and a book, a sports lesson, a job with an airline and an end-of-year play.

lessons.title: Maalinta kowaad ee Ifraax
lessons.summary: Eight-year-old Ifraax starts at a new school in Boorama; she sits on the third chair, answers a sum in her first maths lesson and tells her mother she likes the school.
lessons.text:
Ifraax waa gabadh yar oo ku nool Boorama. Waxay jirtaa sideed sano. Saaka waa maalinteeda kowaad ee iskuul cusub. Ifraax goor hore ayay kacday. Hooyadeed ayaa cunto u diyaarisay.

"Ifraax, saaka waxaad tagaysaa iskuulka cusub. Ma diyaar tahay?" ayay tidhi hooyadeed.

"Waan diyaar ahay, hooyo. Waan faraxsanahay," ayay tidhi Ifraax.

Ifraax iyo hooyadeed waxay u wada socdeen iskuulka. Iskuulku guriga wuu u dhow yahay. Markii ay gaadheen, Ifraax waxay aragtay albaab weyn oo cad. Albaabka hortiisa waxaa joogay arday badan. Ifraax arday cusub ayay ahayd.

Ifraax albaabka ayay ka gashay. Qolka waxaa yaalay sideed kursi. Macallin Mustafe ayaa qolka joogay. "Ifraax, kaalay. Kursiga saddexaad ku fadhiiso," ayuu yidhi. Ifraax waxay ku fadhiday kursiga saddexaad.

"Saaka waxaynu baranaynaa xisaab," ayuu yidhi Mustafe. Wuxuu qoray 5 iyo 3. "Shan iyo saddex maxay noqdaan?" ayuu weydiiyay. Ardayga kowaad waxba ma odhan. Ardayga labaad waxba ma odhan. Kadib Ifraax ayaa tidhi: "Waa sideed."

"Waa sax!" ayuu yidhi Mustafe. Ifraax way faraxsanayd.

Kadib Mustafe wuxuu qoray 4 iyo 4. "Afar iyo afar maxay noqdaan?" ayuu weydiiyay. Ardayga saddexaad ayaa yidhi: "Waa sideed." "Waa sax," ayuu yidhi Mustafe. "Xisaabtu way fudud tahay haddii aad si fiican u barataan."

Markii Ifraax ka baxday iskuulka, hooyadeed ayaa albaabka hortiisa ku sugaysay. "Maxaad saaka baratay?" ayay weydiisay hooyadeed.

"Waxaan bartay xisaab. Shan iyo saddex waa sideed. Waxaan ku fadhiyay kursiga saddexaad. Iskuulka cusub waan jeclahay," ayay tidhi Ifraax.

Hooyadeed way faraxsanayd. Ifraax iyaduna way faraxsanayd.

Su'aalo:
Ifraax ma jirtaa sideed sano?
Ifraax waxay jirtaa sideed sano.
Saaka Ifraax meeshee ayay tagtay?
Saaka Ifraax waxay tagtay iskuul cusub.
Qolka maxaa yaalay?
Qolka waxaa yaalay sideed kursi.
Ifraax kursigee ayay ku fadhiday?
Ifraax waxay ku fadhiday kursiga saddexaad.
Shan iyo saddex maxay noqdaan?
Shan iyo saddex waa sideed.
Ifraax ma jeceshahay iskuulka cusub?
Ifraax way jeceshahay iskuulka cusub.

lessons.title: Birta kulul
lessons.summary: Mursal works iron in the market of Burco; his son Hanad cuts and hammers the hot iron for the first time, burns his hand, and a nurse at the hospital treats it.
lessons.text:
Mursal waa nin ka shaqeeya bir. Wuxuu leeyahay goob yar oo ku taal suuqa Burco. Wiilkiisa Hanad ayaa la shaqeeya.

Maalin kasta Mursal wuxuu sameeyaa qalab cusub. Marka hore wuxuu jaraa birta. Kadib birta dab ayuu ku dhigaa ilaa ay kulul noqoto. Markii birtu kulul tahay, wuu dhufaa. Wuu dhufaa, wuu dhufaa. Sidaas ayuu birta ku adkeeyaa.

Maanta Mursal wuxuu u sheegay Hanad: "Maanta adiga ayaa birta jaraya. Kadib birta kulul dhuf si aad u adkeyso."

Hanad birta wuu jaray. Kadib birta dab ayuu ku dhigay. Birtu way kulushay. Hanad birta ayuu dhufay. Mar kale ayuu dhufay. Laakiin gacantiisa ayaa ku dhacday birta kulul. Birtii kulul ayaa gacanta Hanad gubtay.

"Birta ayaa i gubtay!" ayuu yidhi Hanad. Xanuun badan ayuu dareemay.

Mursal wuxuu Hanad u qaaday isbitaalka. Isbitaalku suuqa wuu u dhow yahay. Daqiiqado yar kadib waxay gaadheen isbitaalka. Ladan oo ka shaqaysa isbitaalka ayaa gacanta eegtay. "Birtu gacanta way gubtay, laakiin waan daaweyn karaa," ayay tidhi Ladan.

Ladan gacanta way daaweysay. Daawo ayay gacanta ku dhigtay. Daqiiqad kadib xanuunku wuu yaraaday. Daqiiqado kale kadib xanuunkii wuu tagay.

Kadib Mursal iyo Hanad waxay ku noqdeen goobtooda. "Hanad, bir kulul gacanta ha ku qaadin," ayuu yidhi Mursal. "Waan ogahay," ayuu yidhi Hanad.

Maalintaas kadib Hanad si fiican ayuu birta u jaraa. Si fiican ayuu u dhufaa. Sidaas ayuu birta ku adkeeyaa.

Su'aalo:
Mursal muxuu ka shaqeeyaa?
Mursal wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa bir.
Mursal sidee ayuu birta u adkeeyaa?
Birta wuu jaraa, dab ayuu ku dhigaa, kadibna wuu dhufaa.
Maxaa gacanta Hanad gubay?
Birtii kulul ayaa gacanta Hanad gubtay.
Mursal meeshee ayuu Hanad u qaaday?
Mursal wuxuu Hanad u qaaday isbitaalka.
Yaa gacanta daaweeyay?
Ladan ayaa gacanta daaweysay.
Daqiiqad kadib maxaa dhacay?
Daqiiqad kadib xanuunku wuu yaraaday.

lessons.title: Xaawo iyo tan madow
lessons.summary: Before the rain, Xaawo milks the animals in her village near Ceerigaabo; the black one with big horns has run up the mountain, and her dog finds it between two stones.
lessons.text:
Xaawo waxay ku nooshahay tuulo yar oo u dhow Ceerigaabo. Tuulada waxaa u dhow buur dheer. Tuulada waxaa ku nool dad yar iyo xoolo badan.

Xaawo maalin kasta goor hore ayay shaqo qabataa: xoolaha ayay maashaa. Kadib caanaha ayay siisaa ilmaha tuulada. Xaawo waxay leedahay eey weyn. Eeygu meel kasta oo ay tagto wuu la socdaa.

Xoolaha waxaa ku jirta mid madow oo geeso waaweyn leh. Xaawo aad ayay u jeceshahay tan madow.

Maanta Xaawo cirka ayay eegtay. Cirku wuu madow yahay. "Roob ayaa iman doona," ayay tidhi.

Xaawo xoolaha way maashay, laakiin tan madow ma joogin. Tan madow ee geesaha waaweyn leh waxay u carartay buurta.

"Kaalay!" ayay u tidhi eeyga. Xaawo iyo eeygu waxay u socdeen buurta. Buurta waxaa yaal dhagxaan badan. Eeygu wuxuu raadiyay tan madow. Kadib eeygu wuu cararay. Xaawo way raacday. Tan madow waxay joogtay laba dhagax oo waaweyn dhexdooda.

Xaawo geesaheeda ayay qabatay. Kadib waxay ka soo saartay dhagaxyada dhexdooda, waxayna keentay tuulada. Eeyguna wuu la socday.

Markii ay gaadheen tuulada, roobku wuu da'ay. Cirku wuu madow yahay, roobkuna waa badan yahay. Xaawo tan madow way maashay. Kadib caanaha ayay siisay ilmaha. Ilmaha tuuladu way faraxsan yihiin.

Su'aalo:
Xaawo meeshee ayay ku nooshahay?
Xaawo waxay ku nooshahay tuulo yar oo u dhow Ceerigaabo.
Xaawo maxay samaysaa maalin kasta?
Maalin kasta Xaawo xoolaha ayay maashaa.
Tan madow meeshee ayay u carartay?
Tan madow waxay u carartay buurta.
Yaa raadiyay tan madow?
Eeyga ayaa raadiyay tan madow.
Tan madow meeshee ayay joogtay?
Waxay joogtay laba dhagax oo waaweyn dhexdooda.
Markii ay gaadheen tuulada, maxaa dhacay?
Markii ay gaadheen tuulada, roobku wuu da'ay.

lessons.title: Maqaalka Cabdiraxmaan
lessons.summary: Journalist Cabdiraxmaan in Muqdisho must finish a three-page article about a new school in one day; he hurries, carries the pages to his editor Xamdi, adds the school's name on her advice, and she signs it off.
lessons.text:
Cabdiraxmaan waa nin maqaallo qora. Wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa xafiis ku yaal Muqdisho. Madaxa xafiiska waa Xamdi. Xamdi waxay u talin jirtay dadka maqaallada qora.

Saaka Xamdi ayaa telefoon u dirtay Cabdiraxmaan. "Cabdiraxmaan, waxaan rabaa maqaal ku saabsan iskuulka cusub ee xaafadda. Maqaalku waa inuu noqdo saddex bog. Maanta waa inaad dhammayso," ayay Xamdi telefoonka ku tidhi.

Cabdiraxmaan wuxuu tagay iskuulka. Arday iyo macallin ayuu la hadlay. Kadib wuu degdegay, wuxuuna ku noqday gurigiisa. Maqaalka wuxuu ku qoray warqad. Bogga kowaad wuu qoray. Bogga labaad wuu qoray. Saacad kadib bogga saddexaad ayuu qoray. Sidaas ayuu maqaalka ku dhammeeyay.

Cabdiraxmaan saddexda warqadood ayuu sitay, wuxuuna u degdegay xafiiska. Xamdi maqaalka way akhrisay. "Maqaalku waa fiican yahay," ayay tidhi. "Laakiin waxaan kuu talinayaa inaad bogga kowaad ku darto magaca iskuulka."

Cabdiraxmaan magaca iskuulka wuu ku daray. Xamdi mar kale way akhrisay. "Hadda waan ogolahay," ayay tidhi. Kadib warqadda saddexaad ayay saxiixday.

"Saxiixaygu wuxuu sheegayaa in aan maqaalka ogolahay. Maqaalkaagu wuu soo bixi doonaa," ayay tidhi Xamdi.

Cabdiraxmaan aad buu u faraxsanaa. Warqadaha ayuu mar kale sitay, wuxuuna u qaaday qolka kale ee xafiiska. Hadda Cabdiraxmaan wuxuu sugayaa telefoon kale oo Xamdi ka yimaada.

Su'aalo:
Cabdiraxmaan muxuu qoraa?
Cabdiraxmaan wuxuu qoraa maqaallo.
Maqaalku ma ahaa laba bog?
Maqaalku laba bog ma ahayn. Wuxuu ahaa saddex bog.
Cabdiraxmaan maqaalka muxuu ku qoray?
Cabdiraxmaan maqaalka wuxuu ku qoray warqad.
Xamdi maxay Cabdiraxmaan ku tidhi?
Xamdi waxay ku tidhi: "Waxaan kuu talinayaa inaad bogga kowaad ku darto magaca iskuulka."
Yaa saxiixay warqadda saddexaad?
Xamdi ayaa saxiixday warqadda saddexaad.

lessons.title: Kabaha Zamzam
lessons.summary: Zamzam sells shoes in the market of Gaalkacyo and washes and oils them every morning; Habiib wants modern shoes for work, picks a black pair and learns how to keep them looking good.
lessons.text:
Zamzam waxay kabo ku iibisaa suuqa Gaalkacyo. Goobteeda yar waxaa yaal kabo badan oo midabyo kala duwan leh: kabo madow, kabo cad iyo kabo cas. Qaar waa kabo hore, qaarna waa kabo casri ah.

Maalin kasta goor hore Zamzam kabaha way dhaqdaa. Kadib saliid ayay ku marisaa. Saliiddu waxay kabaha siisaa qurux. Dadku waxay jecel yihiin kabaha Zamzam, waayo quruxdoodu way badan tahay.

Maanta nin la yidhaahdo Habiib ayaa yimid. "Waxaan rabaa kabo cusub oo aan shaqada ku xidho," ayuu yidhi.

"Kabahan fiiri," ayay tidhi Zamzam. Habiib wuu fiiriyay. Kabahaasi waa kabo hore oo midab cad leh. "Kabahan waa hore. Waxaan rabaa kabo casri ah," ayuu yidhi.

Zamzam waxay u keentay kabo casri ah oo midab madow leh. Habiib si fiican ayuu u fiiriyay. "Kabahani qurux badan ayay leeyihiin," ayuu yidhi. "Qiimahoodu waa maxay?"

"Waa 20," ayay tidhi Zamzam. Habiib kabaha wuu iibsaday. Zamzam kabaha way u iibisay.

Kadib Zamzam waxay tidhi: "Haddii aad rabto in kabahu quruxdooda sii hayaan, bil kasta waad dhaqi kartaa, kadibna saliid yar ayaad ku marin kartaa. Anigu sidaas ayaan kabahayga saliid ugu marin jiray."

Habiib guriga ayuu ku noqday. Kabaha cusub ayuu fiiriyay. Midabkoodu waa madow, quruxduna way badan tahay. Zamzam iyaduna way faraxsanayd, waayo maanta kabo badan ayay iibisay.

Su'aalo:
Zamzam maxay iibisaa?
Zamzam waxay iibisaa kabo.
Zamzam maxay kabaha ku marisaa?
Zamzam waxay kabaha ku marisaa saliid.
Habiib ma rabay kabo hore?
Habiib ma rabin kabo hore. Wuxuu rabay kabo casri ah.
Kabaha Habiib iibsaday waa midabkee?
Kabaha Habiib iibsaday waa madow.
Maxaa kabaha siiya qurux?
Saliidda ayaa kabaha siisa qurux.

lessons.title: Calaamadaha cagta
lessons.summary: At night a shop owner knocks at the police station in Garoowe because his money was taken; officer Ilyaas follows the footprints to a house and finds where the money was hidden.
lessons.text:
Ilyaas wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa booliska Garoowe. Ilyaas il fiican ayuu leeyahay. Wax kasta oo uu arko wuu ogaan karaa.

Habeen ayuu Ilyaas joogay xafiiska booliska. Qof ayaa albaabka garaacay. Mar kale ayuu garaacay. Ilyaas albaabka wuu furay. Nin la yidhaahdo Cabdullaahi ayaa joogay.

"Waxaan wax ku iibiyaa goob yar oo suuqa ku taal. Habeenkan qof ayaa goobtayda galay, lacagtaydiina wuu qaaday," ayuu yidhi Cabdullaahi.

"Ma aragtay muuqiisa?" ayuu weydiiyay Ilyaas.

"Waan arkay. Ninku waa dheer yahay, indho waaweyn ayuu leeyahay, kabo cadna wuu xidhnaa. Muuqa ninka waa sidaas."

Ilyaas iyo Cabdullaahi waxay tageen goobta. Ilyaas dhulka ayuu fiiriyay. Dhulka waxaa ku yaal calaamado. Waa calaamadaha cagta nin. "Ninkani cag weyn ayuu leeyahay," ayuu yidhi Ilyaas.

Ilyaas calaamadaha ayuu raacay. Calaamadaha cagta waxay gaadheen guri yar. Ilyaas albaabka ayuu garaacay. Nin dheer oo indho waaweyn leh ayaa albaabka furay. Muuqiisu wuxuu la mid yahay muuqa uu Cabdullaahi sheegay.

"Waxaan mooday inaad tahay saaxiibkay," ayuu yidhi ninku. Ninku wuxuu mooday in aan qofna arkin.

Ilyaas cagta ninka ayuu fiiriyay. Cagtiisu way weyn tahay, sida calaamadaha. Kabahuna way cad yihiin. "Lacagta meeshee ayaad ku qarisay?" ayuu weydiiyay Ilyaas. Ninku waxba ma odhan.

Ilyaas guriga ayuu raadiyay. Kadib wuxuu ogaanay in lacagta lagu qariyay sariirta hoosteeda. Ilyaas lacagtii wuu helay, wuxuuna u celiyay Cabdullaahi.

"Xor ma ahay?" ayuu weydiiyay ninku.

"Xor ma tihid," ayuu yidhi Ilyaas. Booliska ayaa ninka qaaday.

Su'aalo:
Yaa albaabka garaacay?
Cabdullaahi ayaa albaabka garaacay.
Muuqa ninka sidee buu ahaa?
Ninku wuxuu ahaa nin dheer oo indho waaweyn leh.
Ilyaas muxuu dhulka ku arkay?
Ilyaas wuxuu dhulka ku arkay calaamadaha cagta nin.
Ilyaas muxuu ogaanay?
Ilyaas wuxuu ogaanay in lacagta lagu qariyay sariirta hoosteeda.
Ninku ma xor yahay hadda?
Ninku xor ma aha. Booliska ayaa qaaday.

lessons.title: Buugga Yaxye
lessons.summary: Schoolfriends Yaxye and Anwar in Laascaanood fall out over a book; their teacher Naciimo talks about kindness to everyone, and the two make up and read the book together.
lessons.text:
Yaxye iyo Anwar waa laba arday oo saaxiib ah. Waxay dhigtaan iskuul ku yaal Laascaanood. Had iyo jeer way wada socdaan, way wada cunaan, wayna wada ciyaaraan. Jacayl weyn ayaa dhexdooda ah.

Maalin ayaa Anwar qaatay buug yar oo uu Yaxye leeyahay. Yaxye wuu xanaaqay. "Buuggaygii adiga ayaa qaatay!" ayuu yidhi Yaxye.

"Buuggan aniga ayaa leh," ayuu yidhi Anwar.

Naciimo, oo iskuulka wax ka dhigta, ayaa timid. "Buuggu ma buugga Yaxye baa, mise waa buugga Anwar?" ayay weydiisay. Anwar waxba ma odhan. Wuu fekeray. Kadib wuxuu yidhi: "Buuggu maaha buuggayga. Waa buugga Yaxye."

"Anwar, ma run baa?" ayay tidhi Naciimo. "Haa, waa run," ayuu yidhi Anwar.

Naciimo waxay tidhi: "Saaxiibku wuxuu u baahan yahay wanaag iyo jacayl. Had iyo jeer wanaag u samee qof kasta: walaalkaa, saaxiibkaa, qof Muslim ah iyo qof gaal ah."

"Xitaa qofka gaalka ah?" ayuu weydiiyay Yaxye.

"Haa," ayay tidhi Naciimo. "Gaalku waa qof aan Muslim ahayn, laakiin isna wanaag ayuu mudan yahay. Qof kasta ayaa mudan wanaag."

Anwar mar kale ayuu fekeray. Kadib buugga wuxuu siiyay Yaxye. "Yaxye, buuggaaga waa kan," ayuu yidhi. Yaxye wuu fekeray. "Hal buug ma laba arday u filan yahay?" ayuu weydiiyay Naciimo.

"Haa, wuu filan yahay haddii ay wada akhriyaan," ayay tidhi Naciimo.

Naciimo waxay rabtay in labada wiil ay heshiiyaan. Labada saaxiib way heshiiyeen. Kadib buugga way wada akhriyeen. Hal buug ayaa labadooda u filan.

Su'aalo:
Yaxye iyo Anwar ma saaxiib baa?
Haa, Yaxye iyo Anwar waa saaxiib.
Buuggu ma buugga Anwar baa, mise waa buugga Yaxye?
Buuggu maaha buugga Anwar. Waa buugga Yaxye.
Naciimo maxay tidhi?
Naciimo waxay tidhi: "Had iyo jeer wanaag u samee qof kasta."
Qofka gaalka ah ma mudan yahay wanaag?
Haa, qofka gaalka ah wuxuu mudan yahay wanaag.
Labada saaxiib ma heshiiyeen?
Haa, labada saaxiib way heshiiyeen.

lessons.title: Ciyaarta iskuulka
lessons.summary: In a sports lesson at a school in Jabuuti, Faysal has his young pupils stand, run and do push-ups; Kaafi falls on his nose, it bleeds, and Faysal checks that no bone is broken.
lessons.text:
Faysal waa macallin ciyaaraha ka dhiga iskuul ku yaal Jabuuti. Wuxuu baraa dhallinyarada iskuulka. Faysal wuxuu had iyo jeer yidhaahdaa: "Jidh adag wuxuu u baahan yahay dhaqdhaqaaq. Dhaqdhaqaaqu jidh kasta wuu u fiican yahay."

Maanta dhallinyaradu waxay yimaadeen goobta ciyaarta. "Istaaga!" ayuu yidhi Faysal. Dhallinyaradu way istaageen.

"Hadda gacmaha dhulka saara, kadibna dhulka riixa," ayuu yidhi Faysal. Dhallinyaradu dhulka way riixeen. Mar kale ayay riixeen. Kaafi oo ah wiil yar ayaa dhulka riixay 20 jeer.

"Hadda xabadka kor u qaada," ayuu yidhi Faysal. Dhallinyaradu xabadka way kor u qaadeen.

Kadib dhallinyaradu way carareen. Kaafi aad buu u cararay. Laakiin Kaafi wuu dhacay. Sankiisa ayaa dhulka ku dhacay. Dhiig ayaa sanka ka yimid.

Faysal wuu u cararay Kaafi. "Istaag," ayuu yidhi Faysal. Kaafi wuu istaagay. "Madaxa kor u qaad. Sankaaga xanuun ma ku jiraa?" ayuu weydiiyay Faysal.

"Xoogaa," ayuu yidhi Kaafi.

Faysal sanka ayuu eegay. Lafta sanka ma jabin. "Laftu ma jabin," ayuu yidhi Faysal. "Xabadkaaga xanuun ma ku jiraa?" Kaafi wuxuu yidhi: "Xabadku waa fiican yahay."

Daqiiqado kadib dhiiggu wuu istaagay. Kaafi wuu faraxsanaa. "Laf ma jabin, dhiigguna wuu istaagay," ayuu yidhi.

"Waa sax," ayuu yidhi Faysal. "Laakiin maanta dhaqdhaqaaq badan ha samayn. Berri ciyaarta waad iman kartaa."

Su'aalo:
Faysal yuu baraa?
Faysal wuxuu baraa dhallinyarada iskuulka.
Jidh adag muxuu u baahan yahay?
Jidh adag wuxuu u baahan yahay dhaqdhaqaaq.
Kaafi immisa jeer ayuu dhulka riixay?
Kaafi wuxuu dhulka riixay 20 jeer.
Maxaa sanka Kaafi ka yimid?
Dhiig ayaa sanka Kaafi ka yimid.
Lafta sanka ma jabtay?
Lafta sanka ma jabin.

lessons.title: Amiina iyo diyaaradaha
lessons.summary: Young Amiina in Hargeysa loves planes; she hears an airline wants a young woman to work on its flights, gets to the airport ten minutes early, answers ten questions and gets the job.
lessons.text:
Amiina waa gabadh dhallinyar ah oo ku nool Hargeysa. Waxay jeceshahay diyaaradaha. Kol kasta oo ay aragto diyaarad hawada ku duulaysa, way eegtaa ilaa ay ka baxdo.

Maalin ayay Amiina maqashay in shirkad diyaaradeed ay raadinayso gabadh doonta inay ka shaqayso diyaaradaha. Shaqadu waxay ahayd in ay dadka caawiso marka diyaaraddu duusho.

"Anigu waan doonayaa shaqadan," ayay tidhi Amiina. "Waxaan rajaynayaa inaan shaqada helo." Shirkaddu waxay sheegtay in gabadh kasta oo shaqada doonta ay timaado xafiiska saacadda 9.

Amiina waxay ka baxday guriga saacadda 8. Waddadu way dheer tahay. Waddada waxaa ku jiray baabuur badan. Laakiin Amiina toban daqiiqadood ka hor ayay gaadhay. Agagaarka xafiiska waxaa joogay dad badan. Agagaarka waxaa sidoo kale yaalay diyaarado. Diyaarad ayaa hawada u duushay.

Nin la yidhaahdo Muxyadiin ayaa Amiina weydiiyay toban su'aalood. Amiina tobanka su'aalood way ka jawaabtay. Dabadeed Muxyadiin wuxuu yidhi: "Goor dambe ayaan kuu sheegi doonaa."

Dabadeed Amiina guriga ayay ku noqotay. Way rajaynaysay. Kol kale ayay diyaarad hawada ku aragtay. "Waxaan rajaynayaa in nasiib wanaag ii yimaado," ayay tidhi.

Habeenkii Muxyadiin ayaa telefoon u diray Amiina. "Amiina, shaqada waad heshay," ayuu yidhi.

"Waa nasiib wanaag!" ayay tidhi Amiina. Way faraxsanayd. Hadda Amiina kol kasta oo ay shaqada tagto waxay la duushaa diyaaradda.

Su'aalo:
Amiina maxay jeceshahay?
Amiina waxay jeceshahay diyaaradaha.
Shirkaddu yay raadinaysay?
Shirkaddu waxay raadinaysay gabadh doonta inay ka shaqayso diyaaradaha.
Amiina goorma ayay gaadhay?
Amiina toban daqiiqadood ka hor ayay gaadhay.
Muxyadiin immisa su'aalood ayuu weydiiyay?
Muxyadiin wuxuu weydiiyay toban su'aalood.
Amiina shaqada ma heshay?
Haa, Amiina nasiib ayay lahayd, shaqadana way heshay.

lessons.title: Boqorka iyo duqa
lessons.summary: At the end of the school year in Wajir, the children rehearse for a week and then show a play about a king who listens to an old man's advice about his people.
lessons.text:
Toddobaadkan waa toddobaadka dhammaadka sannadka dugsiga. Dhammaadka sannadka, iskuulka Wajir waxaa ka dhacaya kulan weyn. Carruurta iskuulka waxay dadka tusi doonaan sheeko ku saabsan boqor iyo shacbigiisa.

Bile waa wiilka boqorka noqonaya. Yoonis waa wiilka duqa noqonaya. Suleekha waa gabadha sheekada akhrinaysa.

Toddobaadka oo dhan carruurtu way diyaarinayeen sheekada. Raxma, oo iskuulka wax ka dhigta, ayaa carruurta wax tustay. "Bile, sidan u istaag. Boqorku sidan buu u istaagaa," ayay tidhi. Bile sidaas ayuu u istaagay.

Dharka boqorku wuxuu ahaa mid gaaban. "Dharkani waa gaaban yahay," ayay tidhi Raxma. Kadib waxay keentay dhar dheer.

Maalinta kulanka dad badan ayaa yimid. Suleekha ayaa sheekada bilowday: "Waxaa jiray boqor weyn. Shacbigiisu ma haysan biyo iyo cunto."

Bile oo boqorka ah ayaa yidhi: "Anigu waxaan rabaa lacag badan." Kadib Yoonis oo duqa ah ayaa yimid. Duqu wuxuu taabtay gacanta boqorka. "Shacbigu waa awoodda boqorka. Shacbiga caawi," ayuu yidhi duqu.

Boqorku wuu fekeray. Kadib wuxuu yidhi: "Duqu waa sax." Boqorku shacbigiisa wuxuu siiyay biyo iyo cunto. Shacbigu wuu faraxsanaa.

Dhammaadka sheekada, dadku way faraxsanaayeen. Carruurtu waxay jeclaayeen inay taabtaan kursiga boqorka.

Kulanka kadib Suleekha waxay Raxma siisay hadiyad yar oo ay duubtay. Raxma hadiyadda la duubay way furtay. Gudaha waxaa ku jiray buug. Raxma way faraxsanayd.

Su'aalo:
Toddobaadkan waa toddobaadkee?
Toddobaadkan waa toddobaadka dhammaadka sannadka dugsiga.
Yaa noqday boqorka?
Bile ayaa noqday boqorka.
Dharka boqorku ma dheeraa?
Dharka boqorku ma dheerayn. Wuxuu ahaa mid gaaban.
Duqu muxuu taabtay?
Duqu wuxuu taabtay gacanta boqorka.
Boqorku muxuu shacbigiisa siiyay?
Boqorku shacbigiisa wuxuu siiyay biyo iyo cunto.
Suleekha maxay duubtay?
Suleekha waxay duubtay hadiyad yar.
